problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more: read the page again.
problem.conflict: Someone else changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not right: check the fields.
problem.stepUp: A fresh code is needed for this.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.
problem.offline: The factory’s server did not answer: check the connection and try again.
problem.unavailable: It did not work this time: try again.

held.manage: Needs the right to change customers (parties.manage).
held.hold: Needs the right to put customers on hold (parties.hold).
held.privacy: Needs the right to manage personal data (parties.privacy).
held.erase: Needs the right to erase personal data (parties.erase).
held.archived: The customer is archived: reactivate it first.
held.manageCompany: You may not change this customer’s terms with this company.
held.erased: This contact was erased: nothing more can be done with it.
held.objected: An objection is already recorded for this person.
held.styles: Picking styles needs the right to see styles (product.styles.view).
held.files: Picking a file needs the right to see the record’s files (files.read).

numbers.creditWithheld: Your role does not see credit
numbers.promisesWithheld: Your role does not see orders

credit.noLimitHint: No credit limit is set with this company

withheld.samples: Not shown: your role does not see sample rounds.
withheld.profiles: Not shown: your role does not see measurement profiles.
withheld.repairs: Not shown: your role does not see repairs.

samples.title: Samples in progress
samples.hint: Sample rounds for this customer not decided yet, the earliest due first.

profiles.title: Measurement profiles
profiles.hint: The newest revision per rider and garment; the measurements stay in the profile.
profiles.none: No measurement profile kept for this customer.
profiles.noneRider: No measurement profile for this rider yet.

riders.title: Riders
riders.hint: The people under this team or dealer.

repairs.title: Repairs and alterations in progress
repairs.hint: Garments of this customer being repaired or altered.

status.holdStops: New orders and shipments wait; new quotes show a warning.

team.title: Team
team.hint: This rider is under this team or dealer.

hold.title: Hold
hold.hint: Stop new orders and shipments with a reason; new quotes show a warning.
hold.toggleMany: Several holds are in force: release each one below.
hold.stops: While a hold is in force, new orders and shipments of this customer wait until it is released.
hold.waiting_one: {count} accepted quote waits for its order
hold.waiting_other: {count} accepted quotes wait for their order
hold.waitingHint: After the release, make the order from the quote (Sales › Orders).

dialog.companyHint: One company, or every company of the group.
dialog.wordsHint: People see it on the quote, the order and the shipment.
dialog.stops: New orders and shipments will wait until the hold is released.

problem.why: Say why the account goes on hold.
problem.whyRelease: Say why the hold is lifted.

refused.same: A hold for this reason is already in force there: release it or pick another reason.
refused.company: Not a company this customer can be put on hold in.

po.title: Customer PO number
po.hint: When it is required, an order with that company is refused when it is made without the customer’s PO number.
po.partyOwn: No terms of this company yet: nothing is required.
po.saved_one: The PO number rule was saved for {count} company.
po.saved_other: The PO number rule was saved for {count} companies.

req.title: Customer requirements
req.hint: Packing, labelling, hangtag, document and routing-guide rules; each says where people will see it.
req.emptyBody: Add a rule for packing, labels, documents or shipping, and say where people should see it.
req.replaceHint: The old rule ends and the new one starts in one step.
req.historyHint: Rules are never edited: a change ends the old one and keeps it here.
req.replaceNote: Saving ends the rule in force and writes this one in its place; the old one stays in the history.
req.endReasonHint: Kept with the rule in the history.

field.companyHint: One company, or every company of the group.
field.ruleHint: As people should read it: “Two hangtags per jacket, size label inside the collar.”
field.shownOnHint: Where people will see it while they work.
field.attachmentHint: One of this customer’s files (Documents tab).

req.stylesFailed: The styles couldn’t be read: this rule can apply to all orders only for now.

problem.where: Pick at least one place where it is shown.
problem.styles: Pick the styles, or choose all orders.

refused.company: Not a company this rule can be for.
refused.styles: A style picked is not one of this company’s.
refused.file: The attachment is not one of this customer’s files.

done.replace: The requirement was replaced; the old one is in the history.

privacy.title: Personal data of the contacts
privacy.hint: Why we may keep each person’s details (GDPR art. 6), their consent, and what they may ask: a copy of what we hold (art. 15) and erasure (art. 17).
privacy.notRecorded_one: {count} contact has no lawful basis recorded yet.
privacy.notRecorded_other: {count} contacts have no lawful basis recorded yet.
privacy.rule: Personal data stays inside this record: it is never a filter, a group or a total.

act.basisHint: Why we may keep this person’s details.
act.objectionHint: The person objects to how we use their details (art. 21).
act.copyHint: Everything we hold about the person (art. 15).
act.eraseHint: Blank the person’s details for good; documents the law keeps stay (art. 17).

problem.consentDay: Give the day the person consented.
problem.consentSource: Say how the person consented (a form, a mail).
problem.future: The consent cannot be in the future.
problem.words: Say what the person asked and how (a mail, a letter), without their details.

refused.portalUser: This person still signs in to the portal with this e-mail: end their portal access first, then erase the contact.

done.basis: The lawful basis of {name} was recorded.

basis.title: Lawful basis of {name}
basis.fieldHint: Why we may keep this person’s details.
basis.consentSourceHint: The form, the mail or the call it came with.

basisWhy.CONTRACT: We need the details to quote, deliver and invoice what they order.
basisWhy.CONSENT: The person agreed: say when and how.
basisWhy.LEGITIMATE_INTEREST: Our interest in keeping in touch, weighed against the person’s rights.
basisWhy.LEGAL_DUTY: A law makes us keep it (invoices, tax records).

objection.title: Objection of {name}
objection.body: Recorded once, with what the person asked and how; it stays on the contact.
objection.words: What the person asked and how
objection.wordsHint: Without their details: “By mail on 3 Nov, no more newsletters.”

copy.title: Access copy of {name}
copy.body: Everything we hold about the person (GDPR art. 15): their details, why we keep them, their quotes, inquiries, returns, complaints, mails, messages, links, measurement profiles and portal users. Making it is recorded.
copy.words: What the person asked and how
copy.wordsHint: Without their details: “Request by mail on 3 Nov.”
copy.truncated: Some lists stop at 200 entries: the rest opens from each record.
copy.passOn: Download the copy and send it to the person through the channel they asked by.

erase.title: Erase {name}
erase.blanks: The name, e-mail and phone are blanked for good and the contact is archived as “Erased contact”.
erase.keeps: What the law requires stays: quotes, orders, DDTs and invoices keep their own copies; the audit trail keeps what each change recorded.
erase.words: What the person asked and how
erase.wordsHint: Without their details: “Erasure asked by letter on 3 Nov.”
erase.code: A fresh code from your authenticator app is asked before the erasure.
erase.notErased: Not erased: the code was not given.
erase.stepUp: Erasing personal data asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.
erase.stepUpFailed: That code was not right: try the newest one.

documents.why: They keep their own copies of what they printed: the law makes us keep them.

inboundMails.why: Mails stay as they arrived until the platform lets an erasure blank them.

messages.why: Messages on record threads stay as they were written for now.

auditRows.why: The audit trail is the proof of who changed what.

links.why: Links keep the address they went to: the proof of what was sent.

measurementProfiles.why: They stay with the made-to-measure orders that used them.

other.why: Kept because the law or a document needs it.
